atrium_review.method: Assistant visual review of original perspective RGB plus upper-floor support topology, not surveyed boundaries or automatic semantic detection.
atrium_review.note: These photos show an open double-height lobby and upper balcony/rail. Low ceilings and upper-floor fill must not close the central void. The high roof is not removed. Small unrelated envelope gaps are not labeled atria.

scope: Continuous piecewise-planar display sheets anchored to pre-flat source heights, shared same-level anchors and reviewed atrium void. No whole-session translation, pose graph change, or invented floor-to-ceiling thickness.
